notes: SONNY-4884: highest GLIBC_x.y symbol version the x86_64-linux-gnu ReleaseSafe
release binary (built with -Dopenssl-sysroot) was measured to need. Every apt
(glibc) release base must ship at least this glibc; tools/release_dockerfile_manifest.py
refuses a lower or unknown base. build.zig links that binary against a glibc 2.38
floor, so a future build could need more: the generated in-build
`geode --version` smoke step is the authoritative gate, and this value must be
raised when it trips.

dockerfiles.title: FIPS-validated production release image (amd64 only)
notes: Multi-stage: copies validated OpenSSL FIPS provider from ci-catalog/zig-fips image.
MANUALLY MAINTAINED — do not run release_dockerfile_manifest.py sync on this file.
amd64-only: FIPS-validated OpenSSL provider is x86_64 Linux.
The geode binary must be built with -Dfips=true -Dopenssl_path=/usr/local/ssl.
SONNY-4885: glibc_required is the OpenSSL 3.6.2 libcrypto shipped in zig-fips:0.16.0
(GLIBC_2.38, __isoc23_strtol), which is also the -Dfips glibc floor in build.zig. The
guard checks the runtime base in this file against it, and requires the image build to
run openssl_provider_tree's own `openssl list -providers` as the runtime user.
